description: Demolition of existing outbuilding and construction of a three storey plus basement dwellinghouse with associated refuse and cycle storage and the installation of solar PV panels.
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; text-align: justify; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 12pt; padding: 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of its excessive bulk, scale, massing, detailed design, position, and location, would result in an obtrusive and incompatible form of development that fails to respect the special architectural and historic interest of the Grade II listed building. The works would cause harm to the significance and integrity of the listed building, detracting from its original fabric and historic character.</span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;"> As such, the development is contrary to Section 16(2) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policies HC1 (Heritage Conservation and Growth) of the London Plan 2021, and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the NPPF 2024.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4fc8b245-7fff-609c-b039-7cc6ba736240"></span><span style="font-size: 14px;"></span></p>
